decisions.reason: Transactional email sending builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise and is featured on the home page, so its in-house R&D lets it interpret results and improve the service.
Document capture extends the firm's established electronic document workflows and has a dedicated page, and its own R&D gives it the related knowledge to assimilate recognition technology.
Email and fax conversion is a natural extension of the firm's core multichannel messaging knowledge, so early results are easy to interpret and act on.
Fax delivery optimization sits close to the established fax services, so it is a low-cost feature the firm understands well, even though fax is a declining channel.
Sandbox threat protection builds on the firm's email security offer, where its R&D and messaging expertise support continued learning and improvement.
Multi-engine virus scanning is close to the existing email security services and fits the firm's knowledge base, so it is likely to be kept.
